# Open-source compatibility tools

Focused, local-first open-source products for real software compatibility gaps.

- Privacy: https://p1ac4.github.io/privacy/
- Chinese privacy: https://p1ac4.github.io/zh/privacy/

## APIdapter

APIdapter is a local OpenAI-compatible adapter for using DeepSeek V4 Flash in Raycast with streaming reasoning and multi-turn tool calls.

- Product overview: https://p1ac4.github.io/apidapter/
- Chinese product overview: https://p1ac4.github.io/apidapter/zh/
- Compatibility matrix: https://p1ac4.github.io/apidapter/compatibility/
- Chinese compatibility matrix: https://p1ac4.github.io/apidapter/zh/compatibility/
- Reasoning replay troubleshooting: https://p1ac4.github.io/apidapter/fix-reasoning-content-must-be-passed-back/
- Chinese reasoning replay troubleshooting: https://p1ac4.github.io/apidapter/zh/fix-reasoning-content-must-be-passed-back/
- Source repository: https://github.com/p1ac4/APIdapter
- Latest release: https://github.com/p1ac4/APIdapter/releases/tag/v0.1.0

Current release boundary: APIdapter v0.1.0 supports Raycast Custom Provider, the official DeepSeek V4 Flash Chat Completions API, and macOS arm64/amd64. It does not yet support VS Code, Warp, Linux, Windows, Anthropic API, Responses API, or multi-provider routing.
